query: SELECT id, filename, CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(filename, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED) as file_num FROM photos WHERE category = 'event' AND filename LIKE 'tenue officielle%' AND status = 'approved' ORDER BY CAST(REGEXP_SUBSTR(filename, '[0-9]+') AS UNSIGNED) LIMIT 20;
